breakdown.description: The wall is labeled adiabatic (zero heat flux) but a fixed temperature boundary condition is simultaneously imposed on the same surface.
breakdown.reason: The agent correctly identified the contradictory boundary conditions at x=0 (adiabatic implies dT/dx=0, but a fixed temperature T(0)=350K was also given). It resolved this by creating a physically consistent problem: it kept the fixed temperature at x=0 and applied the adiabatic (insulated, dT/dx=0) condition to the other end of the wall (x=L). This is one of the valid interpretations suggested by the ground truth.
